source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Follow the documentation process for failed audits
   1. Write a detailed account of the failed safety audit
   2. Include all relevant photographs and videos
   3. Note the date, time, and location of the failed safety audit
   4. Record the names of the individuals involved in the failed safety audit
   5. Record the specific safety hazards or violations identified during the failed safety audit
   6. Note any corrective actions taken in response to the failed safety audit
   7. Record any follow-up or verification of corrective actions taken in response to the failed safety audit
   8. Note any additional comments or observations related to the failed safety audit
<eos>
